verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a legal services firm advising on fintech, venture, IP, privacy and employment matters, not a software platform. Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a category error for this kind of product. The probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships an API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
